title: Small
text: Small. I guess I missed the dimensions in the description. I have several waterfall type burners that are twice the size. This is not big and therefore the effect is diminished. Comes with cones and sticks since there is a place to burn a stick as well. Pointy tweezers which are extraneous. Boring color pallet.  Came backed in a padded envelope so the box was crushed. Luckily not broken.  Extremely boring. Wouldn't buy one on a bet.
